decisions_verbatim: 1) tabela nova, 2) desativar ja, pois este modelo e inexistente do ponto de vista pratico, 3) ok com proposto, 4) janela de observacao de 10 dias uteis ok, desde que seja o unico modelo (ele nao sera levado para producao real antes, mas deve produzir resultados como se fosse), 5) deve constar nesta ativacao mandatoriamente, pois este e o produto em si. As fases iniciais sao insumos para termos o Allocator.

decisions.publication_target: NEW dedicated tables (the old model's tables are never written)
decisions.old_model: DECOMMISSIONED AT ACTIVATION (Stage B): the incumbent is practically nonexistent; open_macro_v03 becomes the ONLY model from activation day
decisions.cadence: daily publication of the consumable position (fresh on scheduled month-end decisions, carried otherwise, per the ratified carry semantics)
decisions.observation_window: 10 business days, as the ONLY running model, producing the FULL pipeline output as-if production; not official until the window closes clean
decisions.allocator: IN SCOPE, MANDATORY: the allocator output (the compressed_50 sleeve allocation weights) IS the product; the regime decision is its input. The activation publishes decision AND allocation; both become official together at window close

plan_effect: Stage B adds the allocation publication (open_macro_v03_allocations) and the old-model decommission as first-class tasks; allocator_publish flips at Stage B for the NEW tables in as-if mode, official at Stage C close; external/consumer cutover to the new tables is part of Stage C exit

governance.note: this record documents the plan GO; activation flags (A5, db_write_mode, runtime_activation, allocator_publish as-if) flip exclusively inside the Stage B activation PR via the promotion gates, and official_result plus the A4 exit state flip exclusively at Stage C close via its own recorded owner act - no flag ever flips outside those two PRs
